findings.title: Sensor status in the Sensors table is conveyed only by dot hue
findings.description: WCAG 1.4.1 requires that colour is not the only visual means of conveying information. The Status column of the Sensors table shows one small filled dot per sensor: green for pH probe, EC probe and Oxygen probe, orange for Water thermometer and red for Reservoir float. No visible text, icon shape or position differs between the states. In the deuteranopia capture the green and red dots render as near-identical olive; in the achromatopsia capture all five dots are the same mid grey. The same table appears unchanged in the manual-dosing state and at 320 px.
findings.impact: Colour-blind volunteers, who the context says are on every rota, may be unable to tell which sensor needs attention (top task 3), and may miss that the reservoir float is in a fault state while the reservoir card shows a green 'Topped up' chip.

findings.title: Manual dosing setting reverts to automatic after the page is reloaded
findings.description: A safety setting that the screen confirms ('now manual') should still show that state after a reload, so that what the screen says matches what the pumps will do. Currently, after the grower switches 'Automatic nutrient dosing' off, the status reads 'Nutrient dosing is now manual: the pumps run only when you start them.' After a reload of /, the switch is on again and the status reads 'Nutrient dosing is automatic: pumps A and B top up to EC 1.8.' Nothing on the page shows that the change was saved, such as a time of the switch or an entry in the recent pump events list.
findings.impact: Growers draining the reservoir may trust the 'now manual' message while the shown state, and possibly the pumps, return to automatic. After a refresh of the shared tablet, or when a second grower checks the page, it may show automatic with no explanation, and the pumps may dose into an empty tank.

factor_notes.impact: Critical journey; the setting protects against dosing into an empty tank. The screen's confirmation and the shown state disagree after a reload.
factor_notes.persistence: Recurs on every reload; growers cannot learn their way around it.

findings.recommendation: Keep the dosing mode in a stored source of truth, read it back on load, and show when it was last changed (for example 'Manual since 14:07'). Optionally, record the switch in the recent pump events list.

findings.title: Reading cards do not show the target range behind 'In range' and 'Warm'
findings.description: To judge a reading, a volunteer who does not know set points needs the acceptable range in view. findings.impact: Novice volunteers may not know whether 'Warm' requires action (top task 2), and must rely on memory or the shift checklist to interpret values.

findings.title: The same measurements are named differently in readings, sensors and dosing
findings.description: One quantity should keep one name across the page. The reading card says 'Conductivity' while the sensor table says 'EC probe' and the dosing text says 'top up to EC 1.8'; 'Acidity' pairs with 'pH probe', 'Dissolved oxygen' with 'Oxygen probe', 'Water temperature' with 'Water thermometer'. Sensors are grouped by Channel A/B/Tank, but readings show no channel, so the link between a reading and its sensor is left to the user.
findings.impact: Volunteers who do not know that EC means conductivity may not connect an EC probe fault to the Conductivity reading, or understand the dosing target.

findings.title: Dosing switches back to automatic with a single tap and no confirmation
findings.description: Turning automatic dosing back on while the reservoir is drained should be hard to do by accident. A single click on the switch in the manual state immediately returns it to automatic ('Nutrient dosing is automatic: pumps A and B top up to EC 1.8.') with no confirmation, no reminder about the tank state and no undo prompt. The control sits beside the status text, operated on a shared wall tablet with wet gloves.
findings.impact: A stray tap during reservoir work may restart dosing into an empty tank, the outcome the critical journey is meant to prevent.

findings.title: Manual-mode message refers to starting the pumps but the page offers no way to do it
findings.description: Status text should point to an action the user can take.
